3. The defence case as it transpires from the trend of cross examination and from the written statement and documents submitted by the accused appellant at the time of his examination under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is that the accused persons are innocent and they have been falsely implicated in the case by planting the alleged Ganja and Phensydil. The appellant filed an application before the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.) Kurigram stating that Md. Mofizul Huq and 4 others illegally cutting Government road of plot No. 406 forcibly cultivated wheat therein in spite of protest of the villagers and also subsequently cultivated jute thereon. The Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.) sent that application to the Ulipur Police Station for taking action upon which Ulipur P.S. Case No. 27 dated 25.04.2001 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 360 of 2001 was started against them under section 143/447/431 of the Penal Code. The accused appellant also filed a case being C.R Case No. 163 of 2001 against them. Out of these grudges Mofizol with the help of his nephew Aminul Islam who is a source of Narcotic Control office who in connivance with staff of Narcotics Control office implicated the appellant and his wife in this false case. Accordingly Aminul Islam brought the Inspector, Narcotic Control Officer with force to the house of the appellant in his absence who was then working as a government servant in the office of the Kurigram Upazilla Pasusampad as a Field Assistant on 27.08.2001 at about 11 A.M. and Aminul Islam planting the ganza and phensydil bottles in the pile of jute stick and got them seized by the Inspector Narcotic Control Directorate in the absence of the appellant and his wife and in this way a false case was initiated against the accused appellant and his wife. Further defence case is that the appellant filed an application dated 03.09.2002 before the Deputy Commissioner Kurigram and President of District Narcotic Control Committee. Kurigram for judicial inquiry into the alleged case brought against him and his wife and the Deputy Commissioner got the case enquired into by Mr. Monjurul Huq Assistant Commissioner and Magistrate Kurigram who submitted report on 21.10.2001 after enquiry stating that the case appears to have been started out of previous enmity against the appellant who is a simple man and connected with Narcotic business. 

 6. Mr. S.B. Barua, the learned Advocate for the appellant submits that the judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 12.06.2003 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge are improper, had in law as well as on fact; that the prosecution case as stated in the FIR is opposed to the evidence on record; That the prosecution failed to prove case beyond all reasonable doubt and that the learned Additional Sessions Judge failed to appreciate the defence version of the case that the appellant has been falsely implicated in this case by planting gaza and phensydil bottles in the pile of jute stick kept in his west facing but by Aminul Islam in the absence of him and his wife at the instance of his maternal uncle of Md. Mofizal huq and others against whom the appellant brought allegations for cutting government road out of which Ulipur P.S. Case No. 27 dated 25.4.2001 under section 143/447/431 of the Penal Code was started. He further submits that the learned Additional Sessions Judge also failed to consider that the appellant is a Government servant who was working in the office of the Kurigram Upazilla Pasusampad as a Field Assistant; that the local witnesses of the prosecution has supported the defence story of planting of ganza and phensydil in the pile of jute sticks indirect way by stating the presence of a borka wearing man with this search party and thus the learned trial court failed to appreciate the defence version of the case at all and in view of the facts and circumstances of the case and evidence on record the accused appellant is entitled to get acquittal. 

 10. In the instant case the defence version is that the accused appellant has been falsely implicated in this case by planting the ganza and phensydil in the house of the appellant with help of Aminul Islam who is a source of Narcotics Control office who is the relative of the enemy of the appellant. The further defence case is that Md. Mofizol Huq and 4 others illegally cut government road of plot No. 406 forcibly cultivating wheat and jute therein in spite of protest of the villagers. The appellant filed -an application in this respect against his enemy Mofizol Huq to the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.) who sent the application to the Ulipur Police Station for taking action upon which Ulipur P.S. Case No. 27 dated 25.4.2001 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 360 of 2001 was started against Mofizol and 4 others under section 143/447/431 of the Penal Code. The further defence case is that the accused appellant filed another case being C.R. Case No. 163 of 2001 against Mofozol Huq and others and that is why Mofizol Huq and others out of grudge made a conspiracy to implicate the accused appellant and his wife in this false case by managing Aminul Islam (nephew of the Mofizol Huq) who works as a source in the office of the Narcotic Control Directorate, Kuigram. The further defence case is that accordingly Aminul Islam in connivance with the Inspector of local Narcotic Control Office managed to bring the force to the house of the appellant in his absence planting the Ganza and Phensydil in the pile of jute stick in his west facing but which was open and accessible to all and got them seized by the Inspector of Narcotic Control Office. The appellant stating everything filed an application dated 03.09.2001 before the Deputy Commissioner, Kurigram and the President of District Narcotic Control Committee for making judicial inquiry into the alleged case brought against him and his wife and the Deputy Commissioner got the case enquired into by Mr. Monjurul Huq Assistant Commissioner and Magistrate who submitted report on 21.10.2001 after enquiry stating that the case appears to have been started out of previous enmity against the appellant. This report of the learned Assistant Commissioner Md. Monjurul Huq, Kurigram, caste serious doubt on the prosecution case. It is the established principle of law that if the defence adduces evidence which raise a reasonable doubt on the prosecution case, the accused is enticed to get acquittal. In the instant case, the defence successfully succeeds in raising reasonable doubt about the prosecution case and thus the accused is entitled to an acquittal.
